title: Valid Anagram
description:
Two words are anagrams if one can be rearranged into the other using every letter exactly once. Decide whether two given words are anagrams.

Input format
Line 1: the first word s.
Line 2: the second word t.
Both consist of lowercase English letters.

Output format
YES if t is an anagram of s, otherwise NO.
hints: If the two words have different lengths, can they be anagrams?
Count how many times each letter appears in each word. Anagrams have identical counts.
Comparing only which letters appear (as sets) is not enough: "aab" and "abb" use the same letters but different counts. Use a frequency array of size 26.

examples.explanation: Both words contain the letters e, i, l, n, s, t once each.
